items.description: Remove and replace living-room laminate, underlay and skirting
items.rationale: The bathtub supply leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2, and §§4.2.2 and 7.1.5–7.1.9 cover removal and like-for-like reinstatement of the affected flooring, underlay and skirting. Case 61 supports €535 for removal, €1,305 for laminate and underlay, and €839 for skirting, totaling €2,679 gross.

items.description: Remove, dispose of and replace bathroom floor tiles
items.rationale: The full 6 m² tiled floor was affected, so §§5.2.1 and 7.1.5–7.1.9 support necessary removal, disposal and like-for-like retiling. Case 61 supports €336 for removal and disposal plus €939 for supply and installation, totaling €1,275 gross.

items.description: Prepare and repaint the damaged lower living-room wall
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7 cover preparation and repainting of the damaged lower wall, not the dry ceiling or hallway. Case 61 supports €39.40 gross per m² for the same work, or €788 for 20 m².
